description: Feedback messages (shared/CONTRACTS.md, Feedback). `message` is what was typed; `repeat` builds a long one: `text` repeated `times`, then `suffix`. `expect` is the stored message, or null when it can't be sent (empty after trimming, or over `max_length` Unicode code points). For long messages, `expect_length` says it can be sent and is stored trimmed, with that many code points.

cases.name: an emoji counts as one character
trimming happens before the limit is checked
